answer.says: Good morning, Shri Hegde. I trust the second bedroom is tolerable. The air is thick this morning, overcast and grey; one must move slowly. I intend to sit on the step for a while to read the papers. Do not trouble yourself to rise; the day is young, and the heat has not yet declared itself.
answer.thought: The caretaker has prepared the way, and the other man stands there, a ghost of the bureaucratic error that placed me here. I must address him with the courtesy due to a colleague, even if his presence is a logical anomaly in this house. The air quality is poor, but the newspapers are essential to understand the spirit of the age.
